title: Guaxi Origin
description: New origin that adds a little purple raccoon named Guaxi
body:
# Impact 🟥🟥⬛ # Power List \[🟢 Good | 🟡 Neutral | 🔴 Bad \]
**🟢 Momentum** \[Primary Power\] You gradually become faster while sprinting. After building enough momentum, your attack damage starts increasing. Momentum does not build while swimming, and is lost when you hit an entity.
**🟢 Noodling**   While sneaking and looking at the water, you can fish with your bare hands. **🟢 Resilient Stomach** You have a stronger stomach than humans, allowing you to eat rotten food without side effects. **🟢 Fishing Luck** Fishing with a rod grants you the Luck effect. **🟢 Great Swimmer** You move faster while swimming. **🟢 Nocturnal** Same as Feline: You can slightly see in the dark when not in water. **🟡 Limited Climbing** \[Secondary Power\] You can climb blocks that do not have a smooth surface. **🟡 Small Size** Your tiny body gives you less health, but increases your speed and safe fall distance. **🔴 Faster Metabolism** You need to eat more to keep yourself nourished. **🔴 Light Body** Your small body makes difficult to use heavy armor and tools. *** [![Lightwuz Link Card](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1481422/description_50c0b64d-3ff5-455b-b183-b9ea52af646b.png)](https://www.twitch.tv/lightwuz)
